verdicts.title: {i64,i64} literal struct type reconstructed in three places
verdicts.reasoning: Independently verified against the live source. Lines 176-177 inside the `needs_ret_repack` branch of `_call_lib_func` codegen: `i64x2_ll_ty = llir.LiteralStructType([llir.IntType(64), llir.IntType(64)])`. Identical construction at lines 252-253 inside `_repack_to_i64_pair` and again at lines 272-273 inside `_repack_from_i64_pair`. A grep for `LiteralStructType` and `_I64X2` confirms no module-level constant exists. The finding's evidence quotes are accurate and the duplication is real. Severity of low is appropriate — this is a maintenance smell with no functional defect.
